name: iBreath_mixed_questions
description: Mixed post-trial questions: 50% sync-detection, ~16.7% each of flash-detection, left/right, and image-identification. Physiological (breath) input signal. Eye tracking left to the experimenter controls.

questions.text: Was the fish in sync with your breathing?
Did you see the pink fish flashing?
Was the fish left or right?
Did you see the pufferfish or the starfish?
